headline: Nigerian Naira Fluctuates Against Major Currencies Amid FX Demand
summary: The Nigerian naira strengthened to N1,365 against the US dollar amid sustained demand, while it depreciated past the N1,825 mark against the British pound ahead of the festive season.
why: Foreign exchange liquidity and naira stability are vital for importers, inflation control, and macroeconomic stability in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Nigerian Importers and Foreign Exchange
impacts.why: Divergent movements against the dollar and pound create varied import cost pressures for local businesses.

why_moved: Shifts in official foreign exchange rates directly alter import costs, corporate profit margins, and currency valuation metrics.
